idle.visualReview: Eight restrained row-major idle states, same actor and carbine, right-facing. Frames 6 and 8 remain visually very close and collapse to the same 64-bit difference hash, so strong distinctness is not certified.

move.visualReview: Eight readable contact/load/pass/recovery walk states with weapon registered to both hands. R2 fixed R1's cell crossing, but the whole actor is visibly smaller than idle.

attack.visualReview: Clear low-ready, raise, align, pre-fire, recoil, settle and recovery. Frames 4 and 7 intentionally return to nearly the same aimed silhouette and share a coarse difference hash. No projectile or detached flash.

death.visualReview: Irreversible impact, knee loss, descent, ground impact and terminal settle. Carbine stays with the body. Only tiny restrained white synthetic-fluid flecks appear; no red, dismemberment or recovery. Upright onset is smaller than idle.

reload.visualReview: R3 keeps the complete carbine present in all eight cells and shows reach, removal, empty-well interval, replacement, action and return. Magazine state at the frame-4/frame-5 handoff is visually compact and warrants human approval. Combined row-boundary clearance is 54 px, one pixel below the 55 px target.

sharedDefects: Every selected board is RGB with a shaded/varied magenta matte rather than perfectly uniform opaque #FF00FF. Exact #FF00FF counts range from 2 to 10 pixels out of 1573538; all five fail the chroma contract.

Inter-clip rigid scale is not exact. Bounding-box height is only a proxy because poses differ, but move is approximately 14.7 percent below idle and death onset approximately 13.0 percent below idle; strict scale acceptance is withheld.

Idle frames 6/8 and attack frames 4/7 are not exact pixel duplicates, but their normalized silhouettes collapse to identical coarse 64-bit difference hashes; forty strongly distinct poses are therefore not certified.
Reload R3 fixes weapon disappearance, yet the old-magazine stow to replacement draw remains visually compressed and should receive a frame-by-frame human sign-off.
acceptanceBlockers: Replace or remediate the non-uniform chroma matte under a separately authorized normalization/editing gate.
Calibrate inter-clip rigid landmarks without enlarging from weapon reach or corpse width.
Confirm reload magazine causality and decide whether the 54 px combined clearance is acceptable or requires a new source.
Confirm that subtle idle/attack return phases are distinct enough for runtime playback.
